property_summary: For any inputs to setL1BlockValues the stored hash equals the provided _hash (i.e., c.hash() == _hash); the mutant that xors _hash with _batcherHash breaks this because it can make c.hash() != _hash for many inputs.
change_summary: Replace assignment to `hash` with a different expression that stores a value derived from _batcherHash (xor with _hash) so stored `hash` differs from original.
